### The #HandsOnMetrology 3D scanning portfolio

Get your hands on our versatile 3D scanning solutions at #HandsOnMetrology. Whether the hand-held 3D
laser scanner ZEISS T-SCAN hawk 2, or compact and highly accurate 3D scanners, such as ATOS Q or GOM
Scan 1 - at #HandsOnMetrology you will find the right solution for your 3D scanning task.
* [ Learn more ][40]

## Advanced hardware, intelligent software

Delivering precise scans with detailed resolution at high speed
* ## Triple scan principle
  
  Using innovative projection technology and two high-resolution cameras the systems measure
  reflective surfaces and indentations effectively.
* ## Built-in reliability monitor
  
  Our integrated software provides you with ongoing feedback on calibration status, the measurement
  accuracy, environmental changes, and part movements.
* ## High-speed measurements
  
  Using structured blue light, our sensors deliver full-field 3D coordinates in seconds. Amplifying
  the brightness of the light source enables swift measurements with short exposure times.

## ZEISS INSPECT

Effective tool for analysis

Operating with ZEISS INSPECT, the widely recognized standard in 3D metrology, our sensors seamlessly
guide you through the complete workflow of scanning, inspection, and reporting.

## Experience the performance of portable 3D scanners

Whether you are in the lab, on the shop floor, or out in the field, you need to rely on portable,
metrology-grade 3D scanners that pack a true punch in terms of ease of use, accuracy, resolution,

## 3D Measurement Solutions
* Product Development and Design
  
  Product development refers to all of the stages involved in bringing a product to market—from
  inception through conception and engineering design to product development. 
* Quality control and Quality assurance
  
  3D scanning and probing technologies —handheld or automated—enable QC and QA engineers and
  managers to measure the dimensions and validate the quality of manufactured parts as well as find
  the root cause of issues detected during inspections.
* Reverse Engineering
  
  Creaform’s handheld 3D scanners enable CAD engineers and industrial designers to create 3D models
  from existing physical objects.
* Science and Education
  
  An educational solution for forward-thinking teachers and researchers looking to inspire,
  collaborate, and push the innovation envelope forward by using the latest advancements in 3D
  measurement technologies.

Whether you are in the lab, on the shop floor, or out in the field, you need to rely on portable,

## 3D Measurement Solutions
* Product Development and Design
  
  Product development refers to all of the stages involved in bringing a product to market—from
  inception through conception and engineering design to product development. 
* Quality control and Quality assurance
  
  3D scanning and probing technologies —handheld or automated—enable QC and QA engineers and
  managers to measure the dimensions and validate the quality of manufactured parts as well as find
  the root cause of issues detected during inspections.
* Reverse Engineering
  
  Creaform’s handheld 3D scanners enable CAD engineers and industrial designers to create 3D models
  from existing physical objects.
* Science and Education
  
  An educational solution for forward-thinking teachers and researchers looking to inspire,
  collaborate, and push the innovation envelope forward by using the latest advancements in 3D
  measurement technologies.

### MOTION CAPTURE ACROSS A RANGE OF APPLICATIONS

## Motion Capture for Life Sciences

Vicon delivers motion capture solutions for biomechanics, clinical gait analysis, rehabilitation,
sports science, and veterinary research. Our advanced systems capture high-precision kinematics,
seamlessly integrating with force plates, EMG, and biomechanical sensors to produce clean, reliable
datasets for peer-reviewed studies.

With industry-leading accuracy and real-time tracking, Vicon empowers researchers and clinicians to
drive objective treatment planning, optimize performance analysis, and advance movement science.
Trusted globally, Vicon sets the benchmark for transformative life sciences research.

[EXPLORE OUR LIFE SCIENCE SOLUTIONS][80]
[Create AI Studio]

## Motion Capture for Entertainment

Vicon provides state-of-the-art motion capture solutions for film, television, game development, and
immersive experiences, bringing performances to life at the heart of storytelling. Our systems
deliver real-time visualization for directors, high-fidelity mocap data for animators, and
effortless integration with game engines and DCC workflows. Keep stages in sync with sound,
lighting, and playback for seamless collaboration from previsualization to final production.

From dynamic stunts and sprawling crowd scenes to nuanced dialogue, Vicon streamlines production,
minimizes rework, and ensures unparalleled creative precision for captivating, authentic results.

[EXPLORE OUR ENTERTAINMENT SOLUTIONS][81]

## Motion Capture for Life Sciences

Vicon delivers motion capture solutions for biomechanics, clinical gait analysis, rehabilitation,
sports science, and veterinary research. Our advanced systems capture high-precision kinematics,
seamlessly integrating with force plates, EMG, and biomechanical sensors to produce clean, reliable
datasets for peer-reviewed studies.

With industry-leading accuracy and real-time tracking, Vicon empowers researchers and clinicians to
drive objective treatment planning, optimize performance analysis, and advance movement science.
Trusted globally, Vicon sets the benchmark for transformative life sciences research.

deliver real-time visualization for directors, high-fidelity mocap data for animators, and
effortless integration with game engines and DCC workflows. Keep stages in sync with sound,
lighting, and playback for seamless collaboration from previsualization to final production.

## 事業案内

Arcana製作所で行っている事業のご案内です。

1

### FacTrans フルカラー3Dスキャナー


フルカラー3Dスキャナー
FacTransシリーズの製品開発・販売を行っております。従来のスキャナーで難しかったオブジェクトをスキャン
が可能です。デスクトップタイプのスキャナーから全身スキャナーまでラインナップしています。

[詳しく見る][32]

2

### 3Dスキャナー開発


フォトグラメトリー技術を使用したフルカラーの3Dスキャナーの開発を行っています。被写体に合わせカメラ、
照明の選定を行います。

[詳しく見る][33]

3

### CNCルーター、コントローラー


X,Y,Zの3軸加工機やCNCルーターの製品開発・販売を行っております。様々なニーズに合わせたカスタマイズ・
レトロフィットも可能です。EdingCNCの正規ディーラーとしてコントローラーの販売も行っております。

[詳しく見る][34]

4

### インクジェットプリンター用治具、自動化装置


UVインクジェットプリンターや産業用インクジェットプリンターをロボットなどを活用し自動化する装置の設計
、前後装置との連携やワークを固定する為の治具設計を行っております。

[詳しく見る][35]

5

### 受託開発・自動化装置


メカ設計、電気設計、ファームウェア、ソフトウェア、シングルボードコンピューターシステムの受託開発を行
っています。IoT技術を応用した見える化システム、ロボットを活用した自動化設計も行っています。

[詳しく見る][36]

レトロフィットも可能です。EdingCNCの正規ディーラーとしてコントローラーの販売も行っております。

[詳しく見る][34]

### インクジェットプリンター用治具、自動化装置

、前後装置との連携やワークを固定する為の治具設計を行っております。

[詳しく見る][35]

5

### 受託開発・自動化装置


メカ設計、電気設計、ファームウェア、ソフトウェア、シングルボードコンピューターシステムの受託開発を行
っています。IoT技術を応用した見える化システム、ロボットを活用した自動化設計も行っています。

[詳しく見る][36]

Long Range 3D Laser Scanning for Large-Scale Projects

# Nationwide 3D Laser Scanning Company

Arrival 3D is a dedicated **3D laser scanning company** delivering millimeter-accurate point clouds,
Revit BIM models, and CAD drawings for architecture, engineering, and construction across all 50
states. Explore our full 3D laser scanning services or speak with our team today.

## 3D Laser Scanning Company Built for Projects with No Margin for Error

Arrival 3D is a dedicated 3D laser scanning company serving clients **nationwide across all 50
states**. We’ve completed **10,000+ projects** and bring over 20 years of experience delivering
accurate site data, BIM models, CAD drawings, and digital assets for commercial, industrial, data
centers, school, hospital, oil and gas facilities, and infrastructure projects.

Using Leica RTC360, Leica P-Series, NavVis VLX, and drone-based LiDAR [technology][202], we capture
existing conditions and create as-built documentation. We also deliver digital twins that serve as a
virtual replica or reliable digital record of a facility, supporting virtual tours, asset
management, operational planning, and future renovations.

# Premier BIM Services Group

###### As a premier 3D drafting group, DJM provides BIM coordination, sheet metal, mechanical
###### piping, plumbing, electrical, architectural, and structural modeling, as well as
###### prefabrication drawing and spooling, and 3D scanning services. Contact us to see how we can
###### help with your next construction project.

[Contact us][28]

## DJM Design CAD & Coordination...

###### The team at DJM operates as your building information modeling (BIM) and virtual design
###### company (VDC) providing experienced coordination, project management, and building design
###### solutions for sheet metal, mechanical pipe, electrical, and plumbing trades as well as
###### architecture and structural contractors in the construction industry.

## Full-Service BIM Coordination With Trade Specific Draftsmen

##### As BIM coordination specialists, our team can guide you through each step of the construction
##### lifecycle, from initial drawings to installation. With our full suite of services including
##### coordination, drafting, and 3D scanning, clients can eliminate costs and reduce change orders
##### and RFIs before the project moves to the build phase.

### You are welcome to visit us and experience the difference of having a dedicated team right here
### in the United States of America.
### Stop by today or contact us to schedule a visit to our office in Schwenksville, PA. We look
### forward to meeting you!

###### provide them with the services and deliverables they need including 3D CAD modeling,

# The expertise
# to take it on

## Unsere Services

### ENGINEERING

Du bringst die Idee – wir liefern das Engineering dahinter. Ob CAD-Modellbau, parametrisches Reverse
Engineering oder smarte Simulationen mit Augmented Reality – unser Know-how ist so vielseitig wie
deine Anforderungen.Diese Mischung macht uns flexibel: Wir entwickeln individuelle, praxisnahe
Lösungen, die nicht nur auf dem Bildschirm überzeugen, sondern bereit für die Umsetzung sind.
[ Hier klicken ][90]

### Design

Dein Produkt soll mehr können als nur funktionieren? Unser dynamisches Design-Team vereint
Kreativität mit technischem Know-how. Egal ob Produkt-, Textildesign oder ganzheitliche Konzepte –
wir denken Design von Anfang an mit. Farben, Materialien und Oberflächen setzen wir gezielt ein, um
deinem Produkt Charakter, Qualität und Wiedererkennungswert zu verleihen. Auch Nachhaltigkeit ist
für uns kein Trend, sondern ein fester Bestandteil unserer Arbeit.
[ Hier klicken ][91]

### Fertigung

Du brauchst nicht nur eine Idee, sondern auch die Umsetzung? Kein Problem – mit unserem eigenen
Produktionsteam bringen wir deine Lösung direkt in die Realität. Durch unsere Erfahrung in
unterschiedlichsten Branchen entwickeln wir ganzheitliche Ansätze für komplexe Anforderungen – zum
Beispiel beim Bau von industriellen Testmodellen oder innovativen Prototypen, die genau auf dein
Projekt zugeschnitten sind.
[ Hier klicken ][92]

### 3D Scan

Präzision, auf den Punkt gescannt. Mit unserem erfahrenen Team und modernster Scan-Technik erstellen
wir hochpräzise 3D-Scans – perfekt abgestimmt auf deine Anforderungen. Die exakten Messdaten bilden
die Grundlage für hochwertige Modelle und sorgen dafür, dass du Zeit und Kosten im Projekt sparst –
ganz ohne Kompromisse bei der Qualität.
[ Hier klicken ][93]

## Deine Herausforderung - unser Ansatz

Wir sind ein buntes Team mit klarem Fokus: Zukunft machen.
Umwelt im Blick, Technik und Design im Herzen und jede Menge Ideen im Kopf – wir entwickeln
maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, die passen. Ob großes Projekt oder knifflige Herausforderung – wir denken
mit, weiter und voraus. Und zwar von Anfang bis Ende.

Kreativität mit technischem Know-how. Egal ob Produkt-, Textildesign oder ganzheitliche Konzepte –

mit, weiter und voraus. Und zwar von Anfang bis Ende.

### PARTNER DER INDUSTRIE

Digitale, belastbare Bestandsdaten sind die Grundlage effizienter Projektarbeit – sowohl an
einzelnen Standorten als auch in vernetzten, standortübergreifenden Projekten. Sie ermöglichen den
wirtschaftlichen Einsatz zeitgemäßer, digitaler Kommunikations-, Planungs- und
Projektmanagementtools und tragen wesentlich zur Kostenoptimierung bei.

Neben der Bereitstellung der Bestandsdaten begleiten wir Sie – je nach Anforderung – aktiv in der
Projektumsetzung bis hin zur Projektleitung. Für eine langfristig angelegte, digitale
As-Built-Strategie bieten wir strukturierte, regelbasierte Konzepte zur kontinuierlichen
Aktualisierung Ihrer Bestandsdokumentation. Die Einführung und Anpassung der zugehörigen Prozesse
unterstützen wir ganzheitlich bis zum erfolgreichen Go-Live. Wir digitalisieren und optimieren für
Sie zielgenau mit 3D Laserscanning, 3D Anlagenplanung und unserer spezifischen Beratung, bei der
Ihre Bedürfnisse zu 100% im Mittelpunkt stehen.

[Mehr erfahren][22]
 

### PARTNER DER BAUBRANCHE

DUCTIM-X unterstützt Akteure der Baubranche, die Projektrisiken und -kosten reduzieren wollen sowie
baubegleitende Qualitätssicherung und fortlaufende Terminkontrolle als unabdingbar anerkennen. Die
von uns eingesetzten, einzigartigen 3D-Scanner (statisch und mobil) mitsamt zugehöriger Software auf
Basis eines patentierten Algorithmus bieten eine digitale Bestandsaufnahme bestehender oder eine
stetige Fortschritts- und Maßhaltigkeitsüberwachung im Bau befindlicher Gebäude. Durch die
Erstellung präziser und verlässlicher 3-D-Messdaten des Baufortschritts in Kombination mit dem
Abgleich der Daten mit den beauftragten 3D-Gebäudemodellen reduzieren Sie signifikant etwaige
Änderungskosten auf der Baustelle. Nicht zuletzt übernehmen wir auch die Modellierungsdienstleistung
im ifc-Austauschformat im Rahmen des Building Information Modeling (BIM).

[Mehr erfahren][23]

### PARTNER DER INDUSTRIE

Digitale, belastbare Bestandsdaten sind die Grundlage effizienter Projektarbeit – sowohl an
einzelnen Standorten als auch in vernetzten, standortübergreifenden Projekten. Sie ermöglichen den
wirtschaftlichen Einsatz zeitgemäßer, digitaler Kommunikations-, Planungs- und
Projektmanagementtools und tragen wesentlich zur Kostenoptimierung bei.

Neben der Bereitstellung der Bestandsdaten begleiten wir Sie – je nach Anforderung – aktiv in der
Projektumsetzung bis hin zur Projektleitung. Für eine langfristig angelegte, digitale
As-Built-Strategie bieten wir strukturierte, regelbasierte Konzepte zur kontinuierlichen
Aktualisierung Ihrer Bestandsdokumentation. Die Einführung und Anpassung der zugehörigen Prozesse
unterstützen wir ganzheitlich bis zum erfolgreichen Go-Live. Wir digitalisieren und optimieren für
Sie zielgenau mit 3D Laserscanning, 3D Anlagenplanung und unserer spezifischen Beratung, bei der
Ihre Bedürfnisse zu 100% im Mittelpunkt stehen.

[Mehr erfahren][22]
 

### PARTNER DER BAUBRANCHE

DUCTIM-X unterstützt Akteure der Baubranche, die Projektrisiken und -kosten reduzieren wollen sowie
baubegleitende Qualitätssicherung und fortlaufende Terminkontrolle als unabdingbar anerkennen. Die
von uns eingesetzten, einzigartigen 3D-Scanner (statisch und mobil) mitsamt zugehöriger Software auf
Basis eines patentierten Algorithmus bieten eine digitale Bestandsaufnahme bestehender oder eine
stetige Fortschritts- und Maßhaltigkeitsüberwachung im Bau befindlicher Gebäude. Durch die
Erstellung präziser und verlässlicher 3-D-Messdaten des Baufortschritts in Kombination mit dem
Abgleich der Daten mit den beauftragten 3D-Gebäudemodellen reduzieren Sie signifikant etwaige
Änderungskosten auf der Baustelle. Nicht zuletzt übernehmen wir auch die Modellierungsdienstleistung
im ifc-Austauschformat im Rahmen des Building Information Modeling (BIM).

[Mehr erfahren][23]

## Why experts trust our digital dentistry solutions
* #### Faster workflows, improved proficiency
  
  Save time by working with high-performance software that runs robustly, even when dealing with
  large and complex cases. Quick response times and optimal usability help speed up your daily work.
* #### It’s easy to use and to reach your high expectations
  
  Your complex procedures can become more simple and efficient, thanks to our experience working
  closely with dental professionals like yourself, creating more accessible dental software for the
  digital age.
* #### Flexibility as you require it
  
  Experience maximum flexibility and freedom through exocad’s modular and open approach. It’s not
  just the software that is flexible, the business model is too. Mix and match modules, buy
  perpetual CAD software licenses, or rent the software at attractive rates – it’s all your choice.

  You can rely on us to create software that you will continue to appreciate and profit from. Our
  product has proven its stability time and time again, because we always pay the greatest attention
  to quality and to detail. Our reliable updates provide new possibilities that are always driven by
  your needs.
* #### Independent & innovative
  
  Our software puts you at the forefront of innovation. Since our foundation in 2010, our dedicated
  team of engineers and researchers has consistently developed state-of-the-art innovations for the
  dental industry. As the independent and hardware-neutral technology provider, our goal is to push
  the limits of digital dentistry through software solutions.
* #### Truly future-proof
  
  We’re the dental CAD/CAM software provider with the widest choice of integrated solutions using
  third-party scanners, mills, printers, and materials. And we are always open to new ideas, ready
  to support today’s and tomorrow’s best solutions to meet and exceed our customers’ requirements.

# FairScan

An Android app to scan your documents —
simple and respectful.

“The Simplest Android App for Scanning Documents.” — [ WIRED ][1]

[ Get it on Google Play ][2] [ Get it on F-Droid ][3]
[FairScan screenshot]

## Why FairScan?

### Simple

Scanning a document should never feel complicated. With FairScan, you **get a clean PDF in just a
few seconds.** The application guides you through a straightforward process so you can focus on your
document, not on the tool.
* **Easy flow:** scan, review if needed, save or share
* **Clear**, distraction-free interface
* **Automatic** document detection, crop, and enhancement
* **Instant share:** One tap to export a shareable PDF
* **OCR included:** get searchable, copy-paste ready PDFs.

### Respectful

FairScan was built on a simple principle: it should serve the interests of its users, not the
interests of a business. Its features and code were designed with that perspective in mind.
* **Privacy:** your scans stay on your device. No cloud, no account, no trackers.
* **Focus:** no ads, no nagging to upgrade, only what you need.
* **Freedom:** no watermarks, no page limits, no restrictions on sharing.
* **Transparency:** open-source code, open to review.
* **Minimal permissions:** only what is required for scanning, exporting PDFs, and optional OCR
  language downloads.

## How it works

[Step 1: Detect document]

1. Point your phone – FairScan detects the document

[Step 2: Preview]

2. Preview the scan and adjust if needed

[Step 3: Save PDF]

3. Save a PDF on your mobile device or share it instantly

### Open-source. No tricks.

FairScan is free, open-source, and built to respect you — not a business model.

[ Check it on GitHub ][4]

## Help FairScan grow

FairScan doesn't advertise, doesn't collect user data, and doesn't have a marketing budget. It grows
mainly because people recommend it to others.

### Leave a review

A positive review on Google Play helps other people discover FairScan and gives them confidence to
try it.

### Recommend FairScan

If you know someone looking for a simple document scanner, tell them about FairScan.

### Donate

If you'd like to support ongoing development financially, donations are appreciated but never
expected.

[ Donate once (Stripe) ][5] [ Donate regularly (Liberapay) ][6]

## From the blog

Discover insights, updates, and ideas behind FairScan.

### When a scan becomes a searchable PDF

June 17, 2026

When you scan a document with FairScan, you can now get a PDF which you can directly search for
text. You may also copy any text from it, for example the paragraph you were looking for, and paste
it in another application. This is the result of a text recognition system, which is often referred
to as OCR (Optical Character Recognition).

### Donations, without expectations

April 19, 2026

I've been working on FairScan for almost a year without making money from it. That was never the
goal. But even if money is not what drives the project, it raises questions about sustainability,
expectations, and the relationship between a developer and their users.

[ Read more on the blog ][7]

## Contact

Questions or feedback?

[ contact@fairscan.org ][8] [ Follow on Mastodon ][9]

## Frequently asked questions

### Is there an iOS version of the app?

No. FairScan is currently available only for Android. Any iOS application using the name "FairScan"
is developed independently and is not associated with this project.

### Can I manually adjust the pages of the generated PDF?

FairScan focuses on fast, automatic processing so you can get a PDF in a few seconds. Manual
adjustments are limited to rotating pages, reordering them, adjusting document edges, and choosing
between color and greyscale.

### Where can I download an APK?

APKs are available on [GitHub releases][10]. The SHA-256 signing certificate digest is
`820710961328e1834bcb8158092e6b6c5b519fcd3bdb2e5319ebdaf08f9ea1e8`.

it in another application. This is the result of a text recognition system, which is often referred
to as OCR (Optical Character Recognition).

April 19, 2026

goal. But even if money is not what drives the project, it raises questions about sustainability,
expectations, and the relationship between a developer and their users.

[ Read more on the blog ][7]

### Is there an iOS version of the app?

is developed independently and is not associated with this project.

### Can I manually adjust the pages of the generated PDF?

FairScan focuses on fast, automatic processing so you can get a PDF in a few seconds. Manual
adjustments are limited to rotating pages, reordering them, adjusting document edges, and choosing
between color and greyscale.

## Why FairScan?

### Simple

Scanning a document should never feel complicated. With FairScan, you **get a clean PDF in just a
few seconds.** The application guides you through a straightforward process so you can focus on your
document, not on the tool.
* **Easy flow:** scan, review if needed, save or share
* **Clear**, distraction-free interface
* **Automatic** document detection, crop, and enhancement
* **Instant share:** One tap to export a shareable PDF
* **OCR included:** get searchable, copy-paste ready PDFs.

### Respectful

FairScan was built on a simple principle: it should serve the interests of its users, not the
interests of a business. Its features and code were designed with that perspective in mind.
* **Privacy:** your scans stay on your device. No cloud, no account, no trackers.
* **Focus:** no ads, no nagging to upgrade, only what you need.
* **Freedom:** no watermarks, no page limits, no restrictions on sharing.
* **Transparency:** open-source code, open to review.
* **Minimal permissions:** only what is required for scanning, exporting PDFs, and optional OCR
  language downloads.

solutions. We provide cutting-edge technology and expertise to help you achieve your project goals
efficiently and accurately.

precise and high-resolution data of any object or environment. This data is then processed through
advanced software, resulting in detailed, three-dimensional models that accurately represent the
real-world object.

range of industries, including architecture, engineering, construction, and more. We pride ourselves
on our ability to deliver accurate, timely, and cost-effective lidar scanning services that meet the
unique needs of our clients.

clients throughout the planning, design, and building phases of their projects. Our in-house, highly

ranging from raw data to complete 3D and 2D models.

# 3D Modeling

Welcome to G&P Associates, your trusted partner for advanced laser scanning and 3D modeling
solutions. We provide cutting-edge technology and expertise to help you achieve your project goals
efficiently and accurately.

Our team of technical professionals employs state-of-the-art laser scanning equipment to capture
precise and high-resolution data of any object or environment. This data is then processed through
advanced software, resulting in detailed, three-dimensional models that accurately represent the
real-world object.

Our laser scanning and 3D modeling services are highly versatile, and we can apply them across a
range of industries, including architecture, engineering, construction, and more. We pride ourselves
on our ability to deliver accurate, timely, and cost-effective lidar scanning services that meet the
unique needs of our clients.

G&P Associates is a 3D laser scanning company committed to providing exceptional customer service
and support every step of the way. Our 3D laser scanning services provide extraordinary value to our
clients throughout the planning, design, and building phases of their projects. Our in-house, highly
trained team of BIM/CAD designers and engineers work with each client to build custom deliverables
ranging from raw data to complete 3D and 2D models.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do I need to sign up to use iCanscan?

No. You can start scanning immediately as a guest without login. However, guest users have limited
features. Creating a free account unlocks extra features like Google Drive save, OCR, and more scans
per day.

### What is included in the free quota?

Guest: 5 scans/day, 5 downloads. Free sign-up: 10 scans/day, 10 downloads/day, with OCR and
merge/split features.

### What are the benefits of Premium?

Unlimited scans, no ads, no watermark, Google Drive save, advanced features, and priority support.

### Is my payment information secure?

Yes. Payments are handled by secure gateways. We do not store your card or bank details.

### Can I try Premium before purchase?

Yes. You can use guest or free accounts to test features. Referral rewards also unlock Premium for
free.

### Can I use iCanscan on mobile and desktop?

Yes. Our web app works on desktop (Chrome recommended) and mobile browsers. No installation
required.

### Are my documents private?

Yes. Files are processed securely in your browser. Cloud saves go directly to your Google Drive — we
never keep them.

### Will my scanned documents have a watermark?

Yes, for guest and free users. No watermark for Premium users.

### Can I cancel my Premium subscription anytime?

Yes. You can cancel anytime, and benefits last until your billing cycle ends.

### What if I need help?

Premium users get email support. Free users can access our Help Center and FAQ.

## 3D Scanning

3D scanning captures the shape of a physical part and turns it into usable digital data.

If CAD files are missing—or a part is worn, broken, or hard to measure-3D scanning suppliers can
create a 3D scan/mesh (and, when needed, a CAD-ready model) to support manufacturing via CNC, 3D
printing, or other processes.

[ What do I receive when requesting 3D scanning?
][33]

Typically a 3D scan file (mesh/point cloud such as STL/OBJ/PLY) and, if required, a CAD-ready model
or reference data for engineering.

[ When is 3D scanning needed?
][34]

When CAD files don’t exist, when the part is complex to measure manually, or when a worn/broken
component needs to be reproduced accurately.

[ What should be provided to get started?
][35]

The physical part (or access to it), key dimensions/tolerances if known, intended use, and whether
the output is for inspection, reverse engineering, or direct manufacturing.

[ Can a scanned file be used directly for manufacturing?
][36]

Sometimes, especially for 3D printing. For CNC machining, a scan is often used as input for reverse
engineering to create a parametric CAD model and proper drawings.

## Engineering

Engineering is the step that turns an idea, or a physical part, into production-ready files.

If only a photo, a sketch, or a broken component is available, engineering suppliers can create the
CAD model (3D design), drawings, and DFM guidance needed to manufacture the part using the right
process (CNC, 3D printing, cutting, etc.).

[ What do I receive when requesting Engineering?
][37]

Typically a CAD file (e.g., STEP), technical drawings (PDF), and guidance on materials and
manufacturing method.

[ When is Engineering needed?
][38]

When production-ready files are missing, when a design needs optimisation for manufacturing (DFM),
or when a part must be recreated from a photo/sketch/physical sample.

[ What should be provided to get started?
][39]

Photos from multiple angles, any known dimensions, intended use (loads/environment), preferred
material, and whether it’s a prototype or a batch.

[ Can a part be created from a photo or a physical item?
][40]

Yes. Photos can work for simple geometry, but best accuracy usually comes from a physical sample
plus measurements (or 3D scanning), especially for spare parts.

# Who We Are

Lumispot was founded in 2017, headquartered in Wuxi, boasting a registered capital of CNY 78.55
million. The company covers an area of approximately 14,000 square meters and is powered by a
dedicated team of over 300 employees. Over the past 9+ years, Lumispot has emerged as a frontrunner
in the specialized field of laser information technology, underpinned by a robust technical
foundation.

Lumispot specializes in the research and development of laser technology, providing a diverse
portfolio of products. This range encompasses laser rangfinder modules, laser designators,
high-power semiconductor laser, diode pumping modules, LiDAR lasers, as well as comprehensive
systems including structured lasers, ceilometers, laser dazzlers. Our products find extensive
applications across various sectors such as defense and security, LiDAR systems, remote sensing,
beam rider guidance, industrial pumping and technical research.

# Who We Are

Lumispot was founded in 2017, headquartered in Wuxi, boasting a registered capital of CNY 78.55
million. The company covers an area of approximately 14,000 square meters and is powered by a
dedicated team of over 300 employees. Over the past 9+ years, Lumispot has emerged as a frontrunner
in the specialized field of laser information technology, underpinned by a robust technical
foundation.

Lumispot specializes in the research and development of laser technology, providing a diverse
portfolio of products. This range encompasses laser rangfinder modules, laser designators,
high-power semiconductor laser, diode pumping modules, LiDAR lasers, as well as comprehensive
systems including structured lasers, ceilometers, laser dazzlers. Our products find extensive
applications across various sectors such as defense and security, LiDAR systems, remote sensing,
beam rider guidance, industrial pumping and technical research.

# LOS ANGELES’ PREMIER 3D SCANNING SERVICE PROVIDER

### [3D SCANNING SERVICES][18]

[[Blue Light 3D scanning services]][19]


Mimic 3D is the premier 3D scanning service provider in Los Angeles. Utilizing the best, state of
the art 3D scanning technologies available in the world. We can find a solution that will fit your
project and provide you with the best accuracy and the highest-quality data possible.

[3D SCANNING SERVICES][20]

### [3D SCANNING HARDWARE][21]


From reverse engineering and inspection to motion capture for animation. We specialize in 3D data
capture. Browse our selection of premium imaging solutions including laser, white light, blue light,
probing and more. Find the scanning technology that works for you.

[3D SCANNING HARDWARE][22]

### [INDUSTRIES][23]



Industrial applications highlighting the best  of our 3D scanning technologies. Applications range
from large object aerospace metrology, to micron level inspection. We work with artist and engineers
through all stages of the design process.

[3D SCANNING INDUSTRIES][24]


##### Mimic specializes in 3D metrology, 3D scanning services and 3D scanner hardware and software
##### sales, support and training. Our focus is on 3D scanning, large scale portable metrology, 3D
##### inspection, 3D modeling and reverse engineering. Mimic’s management team have all been in 3D
##### measurement and scanning industry for 20 to 30 years. We provide our customers with the most
##### accurate, highest-quality data possible in the shortest amount of time. We are based in Los
##### Angeles and provide services world wide.

##### With many of our customers in the aerospace industry we do not outsource. All data,
##### communications and service conducted on U.S. soil stays in the U.S. Our customers can be
##### confident that their data will never be sent offshore for processing or analysis. When
##### necessary, we use a minimum of AES 256-bit encryption to protect your assets. We comply to all
##### ITAR regulations and standards.

# Online-Shop für Messpunkte & messtechnisches Zubehör für 3D Scanner

Verbrauchsmaterial und Zubehör für optische Messtechnik sind meist sehr teuer – nicht bei uns! Wir
haben ein branchenübergreifendes Expertennetzwerk zusammengebracht und gemeinsam die
Herstellungsprozesse des Messtechnikzubehörs ganz genau unter die Lupe genommen und Schritt für
Schritt optimiert. So können wir Ihnen Produkte anbieten, die qualitativ denen der OEMs entsprechen,
aber deutlich günstiger sind. Ganz nach dem Motto: hohe Qualität zum niedrigen Preis “Made in
Germany“.
[ zum Shop ][11]

## Produktübersicht

Messpunkte
Ganz gleich, welche Bezeichnung Sie bevorzugen - Referenzpunkte, Referenzmarken, Scanning Targets,
Scanning Dots oder ganz klassisch Messpunkte - bei uns sind Sie genau richtig! Unser Weg als
Online-Shop für 3D Scanner Zubehör begann mit der Entwicklung von Messpunkten. In enger
Zusammenarbeit mit Experten für Druck und Messtechnik haben wir eine kostengünstige Alternative zu
den teuren OEM-Produkten (etwa von Creaform, GOM, Zeiss, Hexagon und Shining3D) entwickelt. Mit
einer Reihe von Maßnahmen konnten wir die Beschaffungs- und Produktionskosten erheblich senken.
Diesen Kostenvorteil geben wir gerne an Sie weiter.
[ Messpunkte ][12]
Scanningspray
Ein weiteres unverzichtbares Produkt aus dem Bereich 3D-Digitalisierung ist ebenfalls in unserem
Messtechnik Online-Shop zu finden: das Scanningspray. Diese speziell entwickelten Mattierungssprays
ermöglichen das problemlose Scannen von spiegelnden und durchsichtigen Oberflächen. Das von unserem
Partner Graichen entwickelte ATTBLIME Spray ist ein technisches Spezialprodukt, das sich nach dem
Scanvorgang selbstständig verflüchtigt, sodass keinerlei Nachbearbeitung erforderlich ist. Die
herausragenden Eigenschaften dieses Sprays, insbesondere in Bezug auf Gesundheits- und
Umweltverträglichkeit, sowie die breite Palette an verfügbaren Produkten machen es einzigartig im
Wettbewerbsumfeld.
[ Scanningspray ][13]
Messtechnisches Zubehör
Wir vertreiben nicht nur messtechnisches Zubehör, sondern arbeiten selbst tagtäglich mit optischer
3D Messtechnik. Somit testen wir unsere eigenen Produkte kontinuierlich in der Praxis und können
daraus Optimierungspotential und neue Produktideen ableiten. Das bedeutet: Unsere praktischen
Erfahrungen ermöglichen es uns, die spezifischen Anforderungen an erforderliches Zubehör zu kennen
und für Sie aktiv die Entwicklung neuer Produkte voranzutreiben.
[ Messtechnisches Zubehör ][14]
Workstations
Vervollständigen Sie Ihre Tool-Kette mit einer maßgeschneiderten Workstation: Die von uns
angebotenen Workstations sind für die Nutzung mit optischen Messsystemen optimiert. Auf Wunsch
können wir diese für Sie vorbereiten, indem wir die Messsoftware vorinstallieren. Die erforderlichen
Lizenzen können ebenfalls über uns bezogen werden.

# NAPS2 - Not Another PDF Scanner

### Scan documents to PDF and more, as simply as possible.

### Scan documents to PDF and more, as simply as possible.

NAPS2 is free and open source scanning software for [Windows][6], [Mac][7] and [Linux][8].

Easily scan with devices from Canon, Brother, HP, Epson, Fujitsu, and more. Then save to PDF, TIFF,
JPEG, or PNG with a single click.

[ Download NAPS2 Version 8.3.2 · Windows ][9] [ Download NAPS2 Version 8.3.2 · Windows ][10] [ More
Files ][11] [ [Download from the Microsoft Store] ][12]

## Use the best drivers for your scanner

Choose between WIA and TWAIN drivers, whichever works better for your scanner. Also choose settings
like DPI, page size, and bit depth. Scan from a flatbed or automatic document feeder (ADF),
including duplex support.

## Rotate, crop, and rearrange images

Drag and drop your pages into whatever order you like. Interleave pages for manual duplex scanning.
Rotate your pages by hand or automatically deskew to the right angle. Use image editing tools to
crop or change brightness and contrast.

## Identify text using OCR

Search through text included in your PDFs by using optical character recognition (OCR), in any of
over 100 languages.

## Use NAPS2 in your native language

Choose from over 40 different languages. If your language isn't available yet, [help translate!][13]

## Share scanners across the network

Use scanners connected to other computers on your local network. Turn any scanner into a wireless
scanner usable from your laptop or phone. [Read more.][14]

## Tools for power users and businesses

* Optional [command-line interface (CLI)][15] for automation and scripting
* [NAPS2.Sdk][16] scanning library for .NET developers
* [MSI installer][17] and [application-level configuration][18] available for group policy (GPO)
  deployment
* [Portable archives][19] available (doesn't require installation)

## Free and open source

NAPS2 is completely free to use for both individuals and businesses, and includes no ads or unwanted
software. If NAPS2 has helped you, consider making a donation.

## RTV Molding

RTV molding is the preferred method for creating high-quality, low-volume parts that look and
perform like injection molded parts. [RTV molding][28] is ideal when quantities from one to 500
parts are required. It bridges the gap between 3D printing and injection molding.

Room temperature vulcanization (RTV) molding, also known as silicone molding and urethene casting,
is ideal for producing:
* Functional prototypes
* Sales and marketing models
* Limited production runs
* Low-volume parts

RTV molding lead times can be as little as three to seven days and typically costs less than plastic
injection molding or machining.

3D printing is a process of creating three-dimensional objects from a digital file using a 3D
printer. The printer uses additive manufacturing techniques to build the object layer by layer.

#### What types of 3D printing services are available?

There are various types of 3D printing services available, including Fused Deposition Modeling
(FDM), Stereolithography (SLA)

#### What materials can be used for 3D printing?

A range of materials can be used for 3D printing, including plastics, metals, ceramics, and
composites.

  [X-ray Diffractometer crystal orientation instrument]
  
  ### X-ray Diffractometer crystal orientation instrument
  
  Raysov RSO30 series diffractometer orientation instrument series is specifically designed for
  semiconductor, photovoltaic, and precision manufacturing industries to provide reliable lattice
  orientation measurement solutions. The system adopts single diffraction/double diffraction
  technology, enabling rapid and precise crystal angle measurement, providing key data support for
  subsequent cutting, grinding, and other processes. With a high-sensitivity detection system and
  stable mechanical structure, orientation Instrument can accurately measure various samples such as
  crystal ingots, bars, and wafers.
  
  ][78]
* [
  [Industrial Spiral CT]
  
  ### Industrial Spiral CT
  
  Compared with conventional vertical industrial CT detection equipment and horizontal CT equipment
  based on object rotation, spiral CT employs a detection method where the test object to be
  examined is horizontally translated. During detection, the radiation source and detector move
  around the object under examination, while the object only requires translational motion.
  Industrial Spiral CT can complete scans in a shorter time, and the horizontal translation
  detection method can process larger samples, making it suitable for inspecting ultra-long test
  object. Meanwhile, the loading and unloading operations of spiral CT are more convenient,
  significantly improving detection efficiency and enabling rapid online detection. Spiral CT also
  avoids imaging motion artifacts caused by the movement of internal components of the object being
  examined, making it particularly suitable for online CT detection of long object.

  [Industrial Spiral CT]
  
  ### Industrial Spiral CT
  
  Compared with conventional vertical industrial CT detection equipment and horizontal CT equipment
  based on object rotation, spiral CT employs a detection method where the test object to be
  examined is horizontally translated. During detection, the radiation source and detector move
  around the object under examination, while the object only requires translational motion.
  Industrial Spiral CT can complete scans in a shorter time, and the horizontal translation
  detection method can process larger samples, making it suitable for inspecting ultra-long test
  object. Meanwhile, the loading and unloading operations of spiral CT are more convenient,
  significantly improving detection efficiency and enabling rapid online detection. Spiral CT also
  avoids imaging motion artifacts caused by the movement of internal components of the object being
  examined, making it particularly suitable for online CT detection of long object.

What you can get

## The deliverable is the point, not the scan.

We measure what already exists, then hand you the drawing or model your team designs and builds
against. Pick the one that fits your work.

### 2D as-built drawings and floor plans

Plans, elevations, and sections with real window and door sizes. The existing-conditions record most
renovation and residential work actually needs.

### 3D and Revit models

Scan-to-BIM models that drop into Revit or CAD, built to the level of detail your workflow calls
for.

### Matterport walkthroughs

A virtual walk of the space you can share with anyone. Walk the site from your desk instead of
driving back to it.

### Point cloud data

The raw measured capture, registered and cleaned, ready for your own team to model or measure
against.

### Sites and land

Drone and topographic capture for exteriors, roofs, acreage, and terrain, turned into site models
and surfaces.

### Objects and parts

Close-range capture of parts, fixtures, and components so fabricators can build to the real
geometry.

Not sure which one your project needs? That is our job, not yours. [Tell us the project][19] and we
sort the deliverable.

Real jobs we capture

## Scan what exists, so what you build fits the first time.

You get exact dimensions to design against. No re-measuring, no misfits, no second trip to the site.

### A commercial property going up for sale

We scanned a printing shop in about 45 minutes. The seller, the agent, and the buyer's architect all
worked from the same existing-conditions capture to plan and market what the space becomes next.

### A custom handrail built to fit a stair

Metal or hand-carved wood, a railing has to land on an existing stair exactly. Scan the stair, hand
the fabricator the geometry, and it drops in without cutting and refitting on site.

### A renovation tying into existing walls

An addition has to meet what is already there. We capture the existing structure so the new design
connects clean, instead of finding the walls are off by inches once framing starts.

### An old building with no drawings

When the original plans are long gone, we capture what is physically there and give you an accurate
as-built to design from, whether it is a historic theater or a working plant.

# Meet the Structure Sensor 3

## Scan anything into 3D.

[ Discover Structure Sensor 3 Discover ][49]

## Our Mission

Translating personalized body data into simple, powerful tools.

[About Us][50]

## How It Works

## 3D Scanning Technology Built for Healthcare and Industry

Structure builds professional-grade 3D scanning hardware and software for medical, clinical, and
industrial applications. Our flagship product, the [Structure Sensor 3][51], attaches to any
compatible iPad to deliver millimeter depth accuracy — enabling clinicians, prosthetists,
orthotists, and developers to capture precise body measurements in seconds.

Healthcare providers trust Structure technology across a wide range of clinical workflows: custom
orthotic and prosthetic fitting, wound measurement, surgical planning, and patient monitoring. The
[Structure Capture app][52] — compatible with iPhone TrueDepth cameras, iPad LiDAR, and all
Structure Sensor hardware — lets any care team member capture publication-quality 3D scans without
specialized training.

Developers building depth-sensing applications use the [Structure SDK][53] to integrate Structure
Sensor 3 directly into iOS apps, with access to raw depth frames, mesh extraction, foot measurement,
and offline licensing. The SDK powers hundreds of apps across healthcare, industrial inspection,
retail fit-tech, and augmented reality.

Structure is based in Boulder, Colorado, and serves customers in over 50 countries. Our sensors are
used in peer-reviewed clinical research, FDA-cleared workflows, and enterprise scanning deployments
worldwide. [Read our customer case studies][54] to see how organizations like [Medi][55], [Rise
Bionics][56], and [Bath Fitter][57] use Structure technology to improve patient outcomes and
business results.

# Meet the Structure Sensor 3

## Scan anything into 3D.

[ Discover Structure Sensor 3 Discover ][49]

## Our Mission

Translating personalized body data into simple, powerful tools.

[About Us][50]

## How It Works

## 3D Scanning Technology Built for Healthcare and Industry

Structure builds professional-grade 3D scanning hardware and software for medical, clinical, and
industrial applications. Our flagship product, the [Structure Sensor 3][51], attaches to any
compatible iPad to deliver millimeter depth accuracy — enabling clinicians, prosthetists,
orthotists, and developers to capture precise body measurements in seconds.

Healthcare providers trust Structure technology across a wide range of clinical workflows: custom
orthotic and prosthetic fitting, wound measurement, surgical planning, and patient monitoring. The
[Structure Capture app][52] — compatible with iPhone TrueDepth cameras, iPad LiDAR, and all
Structure Sensor hardware — lets any care team member capture publication-quality 3D scans without
specialized training.

Developers building depth-sensing applications use the [Structure SDK][53] to integrate Structure
Sensor 3 directly into iOS apps, with access to raw depth frames, mesh extraction, foot measurement,
and offline licensing. The SDK powers hundreds of apps across healthcare, industrial inspection,
retail fit-tech, and augmented reality.

Structure is based in Boulder, Colorado, and serves customers in over 50 countries. Our sensors are
used in peer-reviewed clinical research, FDA-cleared workflows, and enterprise scanning deployments
worldwide. [Read our customer case studies][54] to see how organizations like [Medi][55], [Rise
Bionics][56], and [Bath Fitter][57] use Structure technology to improve patient outcomes and
business results.

###### HOW WE DO IT

## FDM

[DSCF9214.JPG]

Fused Deposition Modeling, or FDM for short, refers to the most common method of 3D Printing, where
material is deposited in layers via an extruding system.


These 3D printers have the largest range of accessible filament-based materials, and feature a few
color options.  FDM 3D printers are generally the most economical printing solution for early
prototypes and practical-use parts.


* Wide Range of Material & Color Options
* Strongest Available Parts
* Lowest Cost of Entry
* 3D Printed Pieces typically have visible layer lines without additional post-processing

## SLA

[INDUSTRIAL SLA.jpg]

Stereolithography 3D Printing, otherwise known as SLA, is an tried and true method of 3D printing
that uses lasers to draw parts from a batch of liquid photopolymer resin.


Rather than deposit material like FDM, an SLA 3D Printer bonds each layer of material to the
previous, allowing for microscopic levels of detail with virtually invisible layer lines.
Stereolithography 3D printing makes up the majority of the 3D printing we do thanks to its large
build volume and smooth finish.


* Smooth and High-Detail printing makes this ideal for artistic applications including sculptures,
  mold masters, and prop production
* Clear, Elastic, Wax and Durable end-use materials are available at smaller volume
* Perfect for casting jewelry and making detailed models that readily accept paint applications


## MJF

[nylon powder.jpg]

Multijet Fusion 3D Printing (MJF)

is a powder-based method of 3D printing where layers of powder are selectively cured with a
combination of binding fluid and heat, to anneal into tough, tensile, and complex functional parts.


At this time, we only print with Nylon PA11 Powder. An impact-resistant functional print material
with a fine surface finish compared to the more common PA12. PA11 is derived primarily from castor
beans.

* Exceptional tensile strength
* High wear and fatigue resistance
* Ideal for functional prototypes and production parts (strong enough for real-world applications
  and testing)
* Great for gears, hinges, brackets, enclosures, and more...

###### HOW WE DO IT

## FDM

[DSCF9214.JPG]

Fused Deposition Modeling, or FDM for short, refers to the most common method of 3D Printing, where
material is deposited in layers via an extruding system.


These 3D printers have the largest range of accessible filament-based materials, and feature a few
color options.  FDM 3D printers are generally the most economical printing solution for early
prototypes and practical-use parts.


* Wide Range of Material & Color Options
* Strongest Available Parts
* Lowest Cost of Entry
* 3D Printed Pieces typically have visible layer lines without additional post-processing

## SLA

[INDUSTRIAL SLA.jpg]

Stereolithography 3D Printing, otherwise known as SLA, is an tried and true method of 3D printing
that uses lasers to draw parts from a batch of liquid photopolymer resin.


Rather than deposit material like FDM, an SLA 3D Printer bonds each layer of material to the
previous, allowing for microscopic levels of detail with virtually invisible layer lines.
Stereolithography 3D printing makes up the majority of the 3D printing we do thanks to its large
build volume and smooth finish.


* Smooth and High-Detail printing makes this ideal for artistic applications including sculptures,
  mold masters, and prop production
* Clear, Elastic, Wax and Durable end-use materials are available at smaller volume
* Perfect for casting jewelry and making detailed models that readily accept paint applications


## MJF

[nylon powder.jpg]

Multijet Fusion 3D Printing (MJF)

is a powder-based method of 3D printing where layers of powder are selectively cured with a
combination of binding fluid and heat, to anneal into tough, tensile, and complex functional parts.


At this time, we only print with Nylon PA11 Powder. An impact-resistant functional print material
with a fine surface finish compared to the more common PA12. PA11 is derived primarily from castor
beans.

* Exceptional tensile strength
* High wear and fatigue resistance
* Ideal for functional prototypes and production parts (strong enough for real-world applications
  and testing)
* Great for gears, hinges, brackets, enclosures, and more...

# Turn designs into interactive 3D presentations to get your ideas across

Meet **Vectary**, an online platform for creating interactive 3D and AR designs, from product
configurators to assembly manuals, that can be securely shared or embedded through a single link.
‍

‍**No downloads, no-code, all in the browser.**
[Create account][28][Let's talk][29]
powerful features

## Everything your 3D workflow needs

Model, import, edit, collaborate, showcase and publish your ideas, all within one platform.
Designers, engineers, product managers, marketers, and many more use Vectary to stay ahead and work
with one of the most efficient in-browser, no-code workflows in the 3D industry.

Find out why more than **4 million users trust Vectary** to bring teams, ideas, and 3D design into
one effective workflow.

Empower small and large teams

## Build 3D interactive experiences to get your ideas across

#### Collaboration

Practical features for communication and sharing. Easy access to projects from any device. File
cloning, in-design commenting, and easy embedding of the whole 3D scene into presentations or
productivity tools.

#### Security

Business workspaces enable company administrators to distribute and regulate user roles, project
access, and other features that improve team productivity without compromising on security.

#### Organization

Set up team workspaces per project, client or department. Scale up as you go. Store your designs and
access them right from the canvas. Share project links with anyone. Make it your integrated 3D
design hub.
[Discover more business solutions][30]
powerful FEATURES

## Don’t just showcase. Explain!

Vectary platform lets you turn product concepts into complete experiences by using interactions,
animations and numerous UI options to get ideas across and get the job done.
[Learn about interactions and animations][31]
Augmented Reality

## Explore spatial design and digital twins

Benefit from having mixed reality tools all within one platform. Import 3D files or build your own
models. View them in Augmented Reality or using VR headsets. No other app needed. Works from your
desktop or mobile phone.
[Augmented Reality features explained][32]
communication and sharing

## Send a 3D viewer that anyone can interact with

Forget about file transfers or email attachments; one link is all you need. Just click on the share
button and make your 3D designs perfectly accessible for viewing from any device, including VR
glasses.

**Try it out. Copy the link and add it to any online productivity tool, presentation or a chat.**
[Copy link][33]

# Turn designs into interactive 3D presentations to get your ideas across

Meet **Vectary**, an online platform for creating interactive 3D and AR designs, from product
configurators to assembly manuals, that can be securely shared or embedded through a single link.
‍

‍**No downloads, no-code, all in the browser.**
[Create account][28][Let's talk][29]
powerful features

## Everything your 3D workflow needs

Model, import, edit, collaborate, showcase and publish your ideas, all within one platform.
Designers, engineers, product managers, marketers, and many more use Vectary to stay ahead and work
with one of the most efficient in-browser, no-code workflows in the 3D industry.

Find out why more than **4 million users trust Vectary** to bring teams, ideas, and 3D design into
one effective workflow.

Empower small and large teams

## Build 3D interactive experiences to get your ideas across

#### Collaboration

Practical features for communication and sharing. Easy access to projects from any device. File
cloning, in-design commenting, and easy embedding of the whole 3D scene into presentations or
productivity tools.

#### Security

Business workspaces enable company administrators to distribute and regulate user roles, project
access, and other features that improve team productivity without compromising on security.

#### Organization

Set up team workspaces per project, client or department. Scale up as you go. Store your designs and
access them right from the canvas. Share project links with anyone. Make it your integrated 3D
design hub.
[Discover more business solutions][30]
powerful FEATURES

## Don’t just showcase. Explain!

Vectary platform lets you turn product concepts into complete experiences by using interactions,
animations and numerous UI options to get ideas across and get the job done.
[Learn about interactions and animations][31]
Augmented Reality

## Explore spatial design and digital twins

Benefit from having mixed reality tools all within one platform. Import 3D files or build your own
models. View them in Augmented Reality or using VR headsets. No other app needed. Works from your
desktop or mobile phone.
[Augmented Reality features explained][32]
communication and sharing

## Send a 3D viewer that anyone can interact with

Forget about file transfers or email attachments; one link is all you need. Just click on the share
button and make your 3D designs perfectly accessible for viewing from any device, including VR
glasses.

**Try it out. Copy the link and add it to any online productivity tool, presentation or a chat.**
[Copy link][33]
